thread:
Talia Reed: Draft for the product launch blog is up. Need a final hero pick for an A/B test, legal quick-pass on benchmark language, and final HubSpot CTA + lead routing. Doc: https://docs.google.com/d/optimize-launch-draft

Marco Silva: I'll toss in two new hero lines that lean harder on outcomes, and a short newsletter subject.

Grace Huang: doing tone sweep now. Suggest we avoid percent ranges in hero; put them in the Benchmarks section with a footnote.

Evan Brooks: CRM ask: what HubSpot form id and desired UTMs? Also confirm the tag/list names for routing.

Talia Reed: use hs_form_id=80808. CTAs should include utm_source=blog, utm_medium=post, utm_campaign=optimize_launch_so. Map registrants to list 'Optimize_SO' and tag 'optimize_launch'.

crm-bot: Confirmed: form id 80808. Suggested CTA url: https://redwood.com/optimize?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=optimize_launch_so

legal-bot: Automated scan: avoid absolute phrasing. Recommend: "Typical 20-40% per-token cost reduction observed in our internal tests; results vary by model and prompt length." Please append a footnote with test harness (model/hardware/seq_len_p95/runs).

Talia Reed: adding footnote: model=llama-3-13b, seq_len_p95=512, batching=dynamic, runs=10, hardware=A100-80GB. Rewriting benchmark sentence per guidance.

Marco Silva: hero A: "Spend less on inference. Keep production quality." Hero B: "Lower per-token cost without sacrificing output." I'll add both to the doc for A/B.

Grace Huang: pick A for newsletter readability; B might perform better on social. I'll tighten body copy once hero is chosen. Also added a one-line customer quote placeholder above benchmarks.

Evan Brooks: Lead routing pseudocode added for ops:
```
if attended && (watched_pct >= 50 || demo_request == true):
  assign_to: sales-sdr-opportunities
  tags: [optimize_launch, webinar_hot]
elif registered:
  nurture_flow: product_webinar
  tags: [optimize_launch]
```

Talia Reed: plan: finish copy edits now, request legal quick-pass, then CRM to provision HubSpot mapping. Target publish slot tomorrow 10:00 PT if all green. Any blockers?

legal-bot: Quick-pass pending final doc link. Avoid words like "guarantee" or "always".

Marco Silva: none from design. I'll export shareables once hero is locked.

crm-bot: I'll standby to create the HS form mapping and webhook; will confirm when done.

Talia Reed: thanks team. ping me when legal clears and CRM confirms mapping and I'll request the publish slot. :rocket:
